effect_measure: odds ratio for severe rotavirus gastroenteritis
estimand: All three trials measure SEVERE ROTAVIRUS GASTROENTERITIS -- the same construct. THE CASE DEFINITION DIFFERS IN STRAIN INCLUSION: NCT00241644 counts disease caused by CIRCULATING WILD-TYPE strains; NCT00362648 counts disease caused by ANY ROTAVIRUS SEROTYPE; NCT02145000 counts laboratory-confirmed severe rotavirus gastroenteritis. A wild-type-only definition EXCLUDES vaccine-strain shedding that an any-serotype definition includes, so the denominators of disease are not identical. NOT incommensurable constructs -- a definitional variance within one construct, declared rather than withdrawn.
pool_uniformity.established_2026_08_18: ESTABLISHED BY READING EVERY REGISTERED PRIMARY, not left as an absent assertion. AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and only one is a finding: this pool was never shown to be unsound, only never checked. Registered primaries read from ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-08-18.

display_change_announced.what_changed: The between-study variance estimator moved from DerSimonian-Laird to REML, so the pooled point estimate and its interval both move.

from.estimator: DerSimonian-Laird inverse-variance on extracted effect estimates

display_change_announced.why: REML is Cochrane's own current default and the Handbook states that 'no single approach is universally preferable'. THE CORPUS WAS ALREADY MIXED -- ARNI published the REML value while others published DL -- so this was never a choice between changing and not changing, it was a choice between one estimator and two.
display_change_announced.a_reader_who_wrote_down_the_old_value: The previous value is recorded above in full. A reader who noted the old number can see exactly what it was, what it is now, and why -- which is the whole point of announcing a display change rather than letting a refinement look like a retraction.

primary.what_a_reader_must_carry: THE CASE DEFINITIONS ARE NOT IDENTICAL. An any-serotype definition can count events a wild-type-only definition excludes, which biases toward the null for a vaccine whose own strain can be detected. The direction is stated so a reader can judge it.
primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.

house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.estimator: REML with Hartung-Knapp, t on k-1 = 2 degree(s) of freedom (t = 4.3027)
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.THE_POINT_ESTIMATE_IS_UNCHANGED: The published point is 0.4941 and the house-rule point is 0.4941. THE NUMBER A READER REMEMBERS DOES NOT MOVE; what differs is the precision claim. That is why nothing downstream catches this -- every memorable quantity survives.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.variance_inflation_floor: A FLOOR OF 1 IS APPLIED TO THE VARIANCE-INFLATION FACTOR so the adjustment can never NARROW an interval below the unadjusted one. That guard is the recognised modification for exactly this instability, and its existence is evidence the small-k behaviour is a KNOWN problem with KNOWN handling rather than a novel judgement.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.no_rule_is_decided_here: The house rule is REML with Hartung-Knapp below k=10, settled days ago. Whether it means ALWAYS or WITH A FLOOR AT k=3 is a decision about this corpus, not a computation, and it has been referred rather than taken. BOTH INTERVALS STAND ON THIS PAGE UNTIL IT IS MADE. Nothing is unpublished and no reader is left with only the narrower one.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.what_this_means_for_this_pool: THE PUBLISHED INTERVAL EXCLUDES 1 AND THE HOUSE-RULE INTERVAL CROSSES IT. A SIGNIFICANCE VERDICT TURNS ON THE INTERVAL METHOD ALONE. A reader shown only the published interval has been told something firmer than the evidence supports; a reader shown only the wider one loses that the contributing trials agree. BOTH ARE HERE.

primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.a_the_setting_may_be_biasing_this_estima: A PUBLISHED INDIVIDUAL-LEVEL ANALYSIS ARGUES THIS KIND OF ESTIMATE IS BIASED TOWARD THE NULL BY THE SETTING IT WAS MEASURED IN. Amin et al., American Journal of Epidemiology 2025 (PMID 39745811), pooled 83,592 infants across 23 countries from monovalent rotavirus vaccine trials. Efficacy against severe rotavirus gastroenteritis appeared to vary from 10% to 100% between countries; after adjusting for local exposure magnitude, all but two countries fell between 80% and 86%. High-burden settings -- which include the African settings pooled here -- are where the unadjusted estimates are lowest.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.b_and_this_pool_mixes_three_vaccines_whe: That analysis held the vaccine class CONSTANT (monovalent) and modelled the setting. This pool combines Rotarix, RotaTeq and Rotasiil -- three different vaccines -- and pools across settings. The two designs answer different questions and theirs isolates a cause.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.c_no_discrepancy_is_claimed: Their 80-86% and this pool's ~51% are NOT two estimates of one quantity: one is exposure-adjusted single-vaccine efficacy, the other is unadjusted multi-vaccine. The finding is about DESIGN, not about a number being wrong.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.a_the_adjusted_interval_crosses_no_effec: READ THIS BESIDE THE ESTIMATE. The unadjusted interval is OR 0.4941 (0.3466 to 0.7045) and EXCLUDES no effect. THIS PROJECT'S HARTUNG-KNAPP INTERVAL AT k = 3 IS 0.2268 TO 1.0764, on t = 4.3027 with 2 degrees of freedom, AND IT INCLUDES NO EFFECT. The house rule already requires the adjusted interval to be shown beside the unadjusted one where k is small; on this pool the two disagree about the conclusion.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.b_and_this_is_not_the_almost_nothing_sur: STATED SO THE CAUTION IS NOT DISCOUNTED. At k = 2 the t critical value is 12.7062 and almost no effect survives the adjustment, so a crossing there is weak evidence. HERE k = 3 AND t IS 4.3027, which is a far less demanding test. There is also real spread: tau-squared 0.0557, Q 4.7195 on 2 df, I-squared 56.97%. The crossing is driven by disagreement between the trials, not by the correction being brutal at tiny k.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.c_what_has_and_has_not_been_done: THE STORED ESTIMATE IS NOT CHANGED. Withdrawing or restating a published number is a content decision. What has been done is to put the adjusted interval where a reader meets the number.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.f_three_different_vaccines_are_pooled_as: READ THIS BESIDE THE ESTIMATE. The three trials administered THREE DIFFERENT VACCINES, verified against their registrations on 2026-08-21: NCT00241644 gave Rotarix, a MONOVALENT human vaccine; NCT00362648 gave RotaTeq, a PENTAVALENT human-bovine reassortant; NCT02145000 gave BRV-PV, a PENTAVALENT BOVINE vaccine. They differ in valency, in strain origin and in manufacturer. A single pooled odds ratio across them estimates the average effect of THREE PRODUCTS, not the effect of a rotavirus vaccine, and a reader deciding about one product cannot take this number as its efficacy. I-squared is 57.6%, which is consistent with that and does not establish it.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.g_the_point_is_reported_to_sixteen_signi: The stored point is 0.4940987113879037 on an interval running from 0.347 to 0.704. FIFTEEN OF THOSE SIXTEEN DIGITS ARE NOISE: the interval is 0.36 wide, so the estimate is not determined beyond the second decimal place. Reporting it at sixteen figures asserts a precision the data cannot carry, and it is the same defect as a displayed value the engine could not compute -- a number saying more than its evidence. The value is NOT rounded here, because it is a published number; what is recorded is that it should be read as 0.49 (0.35 to 0.70).

r_output.what_it_is: The random-effects fit of THIS BLOCK'S OWN per-trial estimates, quoted as the software printed it.
r_output.scale_note: READ FROM THE MEASURE, NOT ASSUMED. This measure is OR, so the fit is on the log scale. The script log-transformed unconditionally until 2026-08-21, which is right for RR/OR/HR/IRR and WRONG for a mean difference -- on this corpus it would have printed 'unadjusted 1685.7331 (162.3105 to 17507.7801)' for a 7.43-point KCCQ difference, and limb 4 stores that output VERBATIM.
r_output.interval_method: REML with the unadjusted Wald interval, and the same fit under Hartung-Knapp beside it. THE HOUSE INTERVAL FLOORS THE VARIANCE-INFLATION FACTOR AT max(1, SE_knha / SE_unadjusted); metafor's raw unfloored value is printed separately and flagged where it is narrower than the unadjusted interval.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: In Multiple trial-declared outcomes: Number of Subjects With Severe Rotavirus Gastroenteritis (RV GE) Caused by the Circulating Wild-type Rotavirus Strain | Occurrence of Severe Clinical Rotavirus Disease Caused by Any Rotavirus Serotype More Than 14 Days Following the Third D, what do the contributing trials show?

It pools 3 randomised trials.

The outcome pooled is Multiple trial-declared outcomes: Number of Subjects With Severe Rotavirus Gastroenteritis (RV GE) Caused by the Circulating Wild-type Rotavirus Strain | Occurrence of Severe Clinical Rotavirus Disease Caused by Any Rotavirus Serotype More Than 14 Days Following the Third D.

Everything in this paragraph is derived from stored fields and none of it is authored. The interpretive sentences that follow are marked as drafts and are the author's to replace.

reviews.title: Accounting for local incidence when estimating rotavirus vaccine efficacy among countries: a pooled analysis of monovalent rotavirus vaccine trials
trial_set: NOT NAMED -- phase II and III monovalent trials, 2000-2012
reviews.trial_set_basis: NOT READ. No included-study list is given in the abstract.
reviews.design: pooled INDIVIDUAL-LEVEL data, Poisson regression, ONE VACCINE CLASS (monovalent) with country and exposure-proxy terms
reviews.outcome_pooled: vaccine efficacy against any-severity and against SEVERE rotavirus gastroenteritis
reviews.estimate_quoted: standard approach: efficacy against severe RVGE varied 10% to 100% by country. With a severe-RVGE-rate exposure proxy: 'VE from all but 2 countries between 80% and 86%'.
reviews.why_not_comparable: DIFFERENT QUANTITIES. Theirs is exposure-adjusted efficacy for a SINGLE vaccine class; this object's ~51% is unadjusted and pooled across THREE different vaccines. No numeric discrepancy is claimed. What is claimed is that their design isolates a cause and this one does not.
reviews.citation: Accounting for local incidence when estimating rotavirus vaccine efficacy among countries: a pooled analysis of monovalent rotavirus vaccine trials. American Journal of Epidemiology. 2025
reviews.scope: vaccine efficacy against any-severity and against SEVERE rotavirus gastroenteritis
reviews.how_it_differs_from_ours: DIFFERENT QUANTITIES. Theirs is exposure-adjusted efficacy for a SINGLE vaccine class; this object's ~51% is unadjusted and pooled across THREE different vaccines. No numeric discrepancy is claimed. What is claimed is that their design isolates a cause and this one does not.

published_comparison.THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_COMPARISON_2026_08_2: THE PUBLISHED WORK ARGUES THAT THE LOW EFFICACY THIS OBJECT REPORTS IS SUBSTANTIALLY AN ARTEFACT OF SETTING. Amin et al. pooled individual-level data from monovalent rotavirus vaccine trials across 23 countries and found that country-to-country efficacy varying from 10% to 100% collapsed to 80-86% for all but two countries once exposure magnitude was accounted for. AFRICAN SETTINGS ARE THE HIGH-BURDEN ONES. This object pools three DIFFERENT vaccines across three African settings to roughly 51% efficacy -- the very kind of estimate that analysis says is biased toward the null by where it was measured. THEY HELD THE VACCINE CONSTANT AND MODELLED THE SETTING; THIS OBJECT VARIES THE VACCINE AND POOLS THE SETTING. Whether to restrict to one vaccine, or to qualify the estimate by setting, is a content decision and is not made here.
